rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters open by acknowledging that the official's departure had long been anticipated but is now imminent, reluctantly accept a resignation whose precise timing depends on a successor, praise the official's abilities in managing complex national-defense responsibilities, and close by noting continued availability for consultation. This combination of distinctive language and parallel structure is stronger than generic resignation-letter conventions. C12 and C19 share meaningful secondary elements, but their overall correspondence is less close.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I deeply regret that the time is rapidly approaching when you will leave Government service.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I nevertheless regret that the time is now at hand when I must accept your resignation
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel framing presents a previously anticipated departure as now immediately approaching.

shared_material.child_excerpt: effective on a date to be arranged
shared_material.parent_excerpt: effective on the qualification of your successor
shared_material.explanation: Both leave the resignation's effective date contingent rather than fixing an ordinary calendar date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The security of the United States in this troubled era requires unceasing vigilance, complete devotion to duty, and a very broad range of abilities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: your many abilities were devoted to the vital task of preparing our nation against any eventuality. In this complex and exacting work
shared_material.explanation: Both praise broad personal abilities and devotion in connection with complex national-defense work.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am thankful that you will be available for consultation with Mr. McElroy
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am glad that you can continue as a member of the Committee and will be available for further consultations from time to time.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the substantive praise by emphasizing continued consultation after resignation.
